releaseNotes: Fixes deep-layer needle targeting: when needleHayId is not in the rendered active set, the hub now reconstructs its slot with the same modulo/generation fallback used by NeedleHaystackClient. The hidden target strand is protected until both live local depth and the required local action count are satisfied; safe hand digging temporarily overrides wide tools, rares, TNT, and new drone deployment around the locked region to prevent premature target consumption and repeated server retargets.
